verdict.rationale: RevenueCat's dashboard/charts and Rico assistant explicitly surface MRR and LTV computed directly from subscription/billing events (revenuecat-docs-6, revenuecat-docs-10, revenuecat-gh-4), and scheduled exports let founders pull this data (revenuecat-docs-7), all sourced from the billing data rather than a bolted-on BI tool. However, the evidence pack never explicitly mentions churn metrics or cohort retention analysis by name, so the story's full metric set isn't documented. Missing for 10: explicit churn-rate analytics, explicit cohort retention analytics/reporting.
